title: Fictional enterprise AI governance policy excerpt
description: A fictional approved AI governance policy excerpt used to illustrate a catalog `policy` evidence record for GOV-oriented examination.
collection_method: Read-only export of the approved policy PDF and metadata card.

scope.description: Fictional enterprise-wide AI governance policy applicable to production AI systems during the assessment period.

population.description: One fictional approved AI governance policy version and its approval record.
population.sample: The complete fictional policy package for version 2.1.
population.selection_rationale: The catalog example needs a single authoritative policy artifact.

relevance.rationale: The policy text addresses the fictional governance obligations under examination.

reliability.rationale: The export came from the fictional controlled policy library with version metadata.

completeness.rationale: The package includes the approved body and the linked approval record.

timeliness.rationale: Version 2.1 was effective throughout the fictional assessment period.

attribution.rationale: Issuer, steward, and approval actors are identified in the metadata card.

integrity.rationale: The fictional digest illustrates verification without asserting real assurance.

traceability.rationale: The example links to a fictional GOV procedure and assessment result.

quality.sufficiency_rationale: A single policy excerpt is limited evidence and needs corroborating procedure and decision records in a real engagement.

limitations: This fictional catalog example does not demonstrate an actual organization's policy control.
Operating effectiveness is not established by the policy text alone.

retention.end_condition: Retain until the fictional assessment archive period ends.

example_notice: Fictional non-authoritative example; no organization, ESAF control, profile, or external framework has been assessed.
